pisces_7.summary: The endurance of faith and spiritual realities amidst the chaotic and obscure forces of life. [4]

pisces_8.title: Pisces 8
pisces_8.summary: A call to participation in the service of the race, as an evolutionary crisis approaches. [28]

pisces_9.title: Pisces 9
pisces_9.summary: The intense mobilization of physical and vital energy to achieve success in a socially competitive arena. [4]

pisces_10.title: Pisces 10
pisces_10.symbol: An aviator pursues his journey, flying through ground-obscuring clouds.
pisces_10.summary: Man's ability to develop powers and skills which allow him to operate in mental-spiritual realms by transcending natural limitations. [29]

pisces_11.title: Pisces 11
pisces_11.symbol: Men traveling a narrow path, seeking illumination.
pisces_11.summary: The capacity inherent in every individual to seek at whatever cost entrance to a transcendent realm of reality. [30]

pisces_12.title: Pisces 12
pisces_12.symbol: In the sanctuary of an occult brotherhood, newly initiated members are being examined and their character tested.
pisces_12.summary: The rigorous testing of an individual's spiritual qualifications before fully entering a higher realm of participation. [4]

pisces_13.title: Pisces 13
pisces_13.symbol: An ancient sword, used in many battles, is displayed in a museum.
pisces_13.summary: The reverence for past struggles and the transmutation of destructive will into a symbol of historical courage. [4]

pisces_14.title: Pisces 14
pisces_14.symbol: A lady wrapped in a large stole of fox fur.
pisces_14.summary: The use of intelligence and protective shielding to ensure survival and comfort in a harsh social environment. [4]

pisces_15.title: Pisces 15
pisces_15.symbol: An officer instructing his men before a simulated assault under a barrage of live shells.
pisces_15.summary: The rigorous training and preparation required to face real life-or-death crises with discipline. [4]

pisces_16.title: Pisces 16
pisces_16.symbol: In the quiet of his study a creative individual experiences a flow of inspiration.
pisces_16.summary: Reliance upon one's inner source of inspiration or guidance to channel a greater collective truth. [31]

pisces_17.title: Pisces 17
pisces_17.summary: The capacity inherent in all great sociocultural Images to unite the members of a community in a display of excellence. [32]

pisces_18.title: Pisces 18
pisces_18.symbol: In a gigantic tent, villagers witness a spectacular performance.
pisces_18.summary: The collective appeal of a well-staged and exciting display of skill and/or oratory. [33]

pisces_19.title: Pisces 19
pisces_19.summary: The transfer of power and knowledge which keeps the original spiritual and creative Impulse of the cycle active and undeviated. [34]

pisces_20.title: Pisces 20
pisces_20.symbol: A table set for an evening meal.
pisces_20.summary: The quiet satisfaction and nourishment found in the harvest of daily efforts and shared sustenance. [4]

pisces_21.title: Pisces 21
pisces_21.symbol: Under the watchful and kind eye of a Chinese servant, a girl fondles a little white lamb.
pisces_21.summary: Growth in consciousness in its earliest tactile awareness of the wonders of unsophisticated living. [35]

pisces_22.title: Pisces 22
pisces_22.symbol: A prophet carrying tablets of the new law is walking down the slopes of Mount Sinai.
pisces_22.summary: The need to bring down to the level of everyday existence the clear realizations made manifest in a great peak experience. [36]

pisces_23.title: Pisces 23
pisces_23.summary: The ability to give of one's own vital energy to substantiate one's conscious ideals or unconscious desires. [37]

pisces_24.title: Pisces 24
pisces_24.symbol: On a small island surrounded by the vast expanse of the sea, people are seen living in close interaction.
pisces_24.summary: The need to consciously accept one's own personal limitations in order to concentrate one's energies and to live a centered life. [38]

pisces_25.title: Pisces 25
pisces_25.symbol: A religious organization succeeds in overcoming the corrupting influence of perverted practices and materialized ideals.
pisces_25.summary: The power of the Soul to intervene in the personal life and to induce necessary catharses. [39]

pisces_26.title: Pisces 26
pisces_26.symbol: Watching the very thin moon crescent appearing at sunset, different people realize that the time has come to go ahead with their different projects.
pisces_26.summary: A keen appreciation of the value of individualized responses to any challenge of life. [40]

pisces_27.title: Pisces 27
pisces_27.symbol: The harvest moon illumines a clear autumnal sky.
pisces_27.summary: The light of fulfillment that blesses work well done. [41]

pisces_28.title: Pisces 28
pisces_28.symbol: A fertile garden under the full moon.
pisces_28.summary: The realization of the abundance and fullness of life's energies when one's work has reached its culmination. [5]

pisces_29.title: Pisces 29
pisces_29.symbol: Light breaking into many colors as it passes through a prism.
pisces_29.summary: The analytical power of the mind to differentiate the unity of existence into a multiplicity of details. [5]

pisces_30.title: Pisces 30
pisces_30.symbol: A majestic rock formation resembling a face is idealized by a boy who takes it as his ideal of greatness, and as he grows up, begins to look like it.
pisces_30.summary: The power of clearly visualized ideals to mold the life of the visualizer. [42]
